# TASK F - board footprint as drawn, verbatim, vs the vendor's recommended land pattern

Blocks are copied out of `*PARTDECAL*` untouched. Coordinates are PADS ASCII
integers, **38100 units = 1 mil**. Do not trust the decal name as a chip name
(the STM32F746 sits on a pad group called `STM32F429_LQFP100`).

---
